value: Two charter fields answer 'how does this component learn?' — `learns` and `how_it_learns` — they disagree in 70 of 70 charters and flatly contradict each other (yes vs no) in 36, and the sieve that was built to enforce the question reads green over all of them because it checks presence, not agreement.

None blocking — the build is specified and the evidence settles which field survives. One thing you may want to see rather than decide, flagged because it is about YOUR corpus and not about the code: the 2026-08-31 backfill wrote 67 answers to a question 70 charters had already answered, and nobody read the existing answers first. That is a pattern about how I backfill, not about this field, and if you want it recorded as a CC failure mode rather than just fixed here, say so and I will write it to the failure-mode store alongside the presence-check shape.

RECORDED (CC, 2026-09-09): the backfill-without-reading pattern is written to the failure-mode store as memory `backfill-writes-beside-without-reading` (~/.claude/projects/-home-akien-dev-src-cairn/memory/), beside the presence-check shape. Nothing here waits at the gate.
